title: Reading Drill — Improving a school's lost-item shelf — A pilot study
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Improving a school's lost-item shelf — A pilot study
passages.body:
**A** A project in Bramley began with reports of small items becoming hidden behind larger bags. The school caretaker had heard several complaints, but individual reports could not show how often the problem occurred. The team collected evidence using claim notes and chose the number of items recovered as its main measure. That allowed it to compare different days using the same rule.

**B** The proposed response was separate trays by item size. Rather than apply it immediately across the whole site, the team ran a trial in a single area. The trial lasted three weeks. A second area kept its previous arrangements, making it possible to see whether any change occurred at both sites.

**C** The first review recorded new items being added at lunchtime as a factor that could affect the comparison. The team advised repeating the study under different conditions before drawing a wider conclusion. It kept the evidence from the first trial but published a note about why the figures might not apply elsewhere.
